hard_deny: supabase db reset — this drops and recreates the database and destroys data no local migration can reproduce. Never allow, even if explicitly requested.

Never write, print, log, commit, or expose the Supabase service_role key anywhere in client-side code, environment files intended for client use, or any output visible outside this session. Only the anon/publishable key (VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) is safe for client code.
